title: Enforce raw-PII rejection and privacy-minimized VA runtime traces
originating_goal: Complete PII-RDY-06 by installing a production privacy gate before VA route classification or generation, accepting only sanitized derived context, and proving retained runtime evidence excludes prompts, raw documents, direct identifiers, credentials, model content, traces, logs, and medical narrative.
validated_properties: Raw-PII questions are rejected before classifier invocation.
Raw-document, credential, identity, prompt, trace, log, model-content, name, address, birth-date, token, and direct-identifier fields fail closed before generator invocation.
Rejected values and hashes of rejected inputs are absent from dispatcher records, privacy events, receipts, and hosted logs.
Accepted public and sanitized-document routes remain governed and hash-bound.
Ten negative fixture classes pass in GitHub Actions.
The retained event is privacy-minimized and suitable for later custody intake without claiming custody or reconstruction.
Provider, filing, adjudication, medical, publication, deployment, and activation authority remain false.
next_owners: master-records/orchestration#15 for PII-RDY-07 operational custody and reconstruction
StegVerse-Labs/Site#116 for PII-RDY-01 through PII-RDY-03 production evidence
collision_boundaries: Do not treat this PASS as Site#116 production detector, redaction, or leakage completion.

Do not treat privacy validation as provider execution, custody, reconstruction, filing, submission, representation, adjudication, rating, medical, publication, deployment, or Site activation authority.
